name: Chisel
lede: Ted Leo, John Dugan and Chris Infante started Chisel at Notre Dame in 1990, hardcore kids going back to the Clash, Buzzcocks and the Jam. They moved to DC, made two albums and split in 1997.

facts.h: Two hardcore kids at Notre Dame went back to the Clash and Buzzcocks
facts.p: Leo came from Citizens Arrest and Dugan from Indian Summer, and the plan was to "get back to what originally got us into punk in the first place." Mod records like the Jam and Small Faces came next.

facts.h: In DC they landed next to the Make-Up and the Dismemberment Plan
facts.p: Their second album, Set You Free, came out in 1997, months before the band broke up.

facts.h: First show in 26 years, at the Empty Bottle
facts.p: Chisel played Chicago on February 16, 2023, a warm-up for the Numero Twenty festival in Los Angeles, with Numero reissuing Set You Free.
